page.content:
Han emperor who sent Zhang Qian and fought for the Hexi Corridor.

How Emperor Wu of Han connects

  • Character: Zhang Qian — Zhang Qian traveled as Emperor Wu's envoy to the Western Regions.
  • Faction: Han dynasty — Emperor Wu drove Han expansion into the corridor and the Tarim.

What is Emperor Wu of Han?

Emperor Wu (r. 141–87 BCE) pushed Han power into the Gansu corridor and Ferghana horse country, the political beginning of a sustained Chinese stake in the overland road.

Key threads lead to Zhang Qian and Han dynasty.
